title: Potential for Foreign-based Social Media Platforms to Manipulate Algorithms to Privilege or Disadvantage Reach of Particular Candidates during Election Period
what_it_is: Potential for Foreign-based Social Media Platforms to Manipulate Algorithms to Privilege or Disadvantage Reach of Particular Candidates during Election Period

sections.label: Foreign interference via algorithms
sections.summary: Deliberate algorithm manipulation by foreign persons or entities to affect domestic politics would constitute foreign interference, and FICA provisions may be used against it.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: If algorithms are deliberately manipulated by foreign persons or entities, including social media companies, to affect our domestic politics, that would constitute foreign interference.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Various provisions under the Foreign Interference Countermeasures Act 2021 (FICA) may be used to act against algorithmically driven online foreign interference, particularly hostile information campaigns driven by foreign actors to influence our elections.

sections.label: Engaging social media companies
sections.summary: The Government will engage social media companies before the upcoming General Elections to remind them to comply with applicable laws, especially on foreign interference.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Government will engage social media companies ahead of the upcoming General Elections to remind them of the need to comply with applicable laws, especially those concerning foreign interference.

sections.label: 2024 FICA enforcement actions
sections.summary: In 2024, the Government issued FICA account restriction directions against 95 social media accounts and blocked 10 inauthentic websites.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: In 2024, the Government had issued FICA account restriction directions against a network of 95 social media accounts and also blocked 10 inauthentic websites that could potentially be used to mount hostile information campaigns against Singapore.

sections.label: Openness and US election allegations
sections.summary: The Government is open to engagements on the evolving threat landscape, and recent years have seen allegations of foreign interference in elections, notably the 2024 US elections.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Indeed, the Government is open to conversations and engagements, because this is an evolving threat landscape and we would desire to hear from academics, as well as social media companies, as to the trends they are seeing.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: And also, in recent years, there have also been allegations of foreign interference in elections through social media platforms, most notably during the 2024 United States (US) elections, where it was alleged that a social media bot farm, comprising over 900 social media accounts, had spread disinformation in the US and abroad.
